parameters.query:
-- Addresses from the chosen source lists that have never been checked.
--
-- `sources` is comma-separated multi-value, so match per element -- never
-- with = on the whole field, which silently drops rows carrying two tags.
--
-- Left out on purpose:
--   company do_not_contact / unsubscribed / in_touch -- blocked, or already
--                                                       in a live thread
--   email_status = 'bounced'   -- already known dead, no point paying
--   malformed addresses        -- a scraper wrote the literal string
--                                 "not found" into some and cut others off
--                                 before the TLD. A verifier charges for each
--                                 and can only ever answer "invalid".
--
-- THE DRAW IS BY COMPANY, NOT BY ADDRESS. `pool` picks companies at random,
-- then every unchecked address at those companies comes along. "300
-- companies" therefore means a fair 300-company slice of the list, not 300
-- addresses that might cluster on a handful of firms.
--
-- Company-less contacts (freemail with no companies row) have no company to
-- draw, so they only take part when COMPANIES = 0 -- see the final WHERE.
--
-- Re-run guard is verification_checked_at: stopping and restarting never pays
-- for the same address twice. A restart draws a fresh random slice from
-- whatever is still unchecked, which is still a fair sample.
with settings as (
  select '{{ $('Run settings').first().json.sources }}' as sources,
         {{ $('Run settings').first().json.only_this_source }}::boolean as only_this_source,
         {{ $('Run settings').first().json.skip_contacted }}::boolean   as skip_contacted,
         {{ $('Run settings').first().json.no_cap }}::boolean           as no_cap
),
usable as (
  -- one row per address that is actually worth paying to check
  select c.id, c.email, c.company_key
    from contacts c
   where c.verification_checked_at is null
     and c.email_status is distinct from 'bounced'
     and lower(c.email) ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+\.[a-z]{2,}$'
     and exists (
           select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(c.sources, ',')) s
            where trim(s) = any (string_to_array((select sources from settings), '|'))
         )
),
pool as (
  select co.company_key
    from companies co, settings st
   where co.contact_status is null
     and exists (select 1 from usable u where u.company_key = co.company_key)
     and (not st.only_this_source
          or array_length(string_to_array(co.sources, ','), 1) = 1)
     and (not st.skip_contacted
          or not exists (select 1 from outreach_log o
                          where o.company_key = co.company_key))
   order by random()
   limit {{ $('Run settings').first().json.company_limit }}
)
select u.id, u.email
  from usable u, settings st
 where u.company_key in (select company_key from pool)
    or (u.company_key is null and st.no_cap)
 order by u.id;
